name: british-auction-rfq
description: RFQ platform with British Auction bidding: auto-extension, forced close, configurable triggers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
